topic: What a GoMining digital miner is
hook: A mining machine you never have to plug in? Here's the idea.

scenes.narration: Per a third-party explainer, a GoMining digital miner is an NFT representing a share of hashrate hosted in GoMining's data centres.
Each one has a hashrate in terahashes per second and an efficiency in watts per terahash.
You own the digital miner, not the physical machine, so always read the platform's own terms.

cta: Learn more about GoMining through the link on my channel page. It's a referral link, so I may earn a benefit.
